label: S00 server and limits
query: SELECT version() AS server_version, timezone() AS tz, getSetting('max_result_rows') AS max_result_rows, getSetting('result_overflow_mode') AS result_overflow_mode, getSetting('max_rows_to_read') AS max_rows_to_read, getSetting('max_bytes_to_read') AS max_bytes_to_read, getSetting('read_overflow_mode') AS read_overflow_mode, getSetting('max_execution_time') AS max_execution_time, getSetting('readonly') AS readonly FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: S01 changed settings
query: SELECT name, value, type FROM system.settings WHERE changed ORDER BY name FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: S02 schema
query: SELECT name, engine, sorting_key, primary_key, create_table_query FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'pypi' ORDER BY name FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: S03 columns
query: SELECT table, position, name, type FROM system.columns WHERE database = 'pypi' ORDER BY table, position FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: S04 can a query set read_overflow_mode to throw
query: SELECT getSetting('read_overflow_mode') AS read_overflow_mode, getSetting('max_rows_to_read') AS max_rows_to_read SETTINGS read_overflow_mode = 'throw' FORMAT CSVWithNames
